issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for SealSaloon.checkOrderReady: The problem statement (UML and textual description) specifies a public method checkOrderReady() with no parameters (SealSaloon.checkOrderReady(): void). The solution implementation defines a public method checkOrderReady(boolean enableLogging) and orderMeal() calls checkOrderReady(true). This deviates from the documented API and can confuse students who will implement the no-argument method as required by the spec and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution to provide the public signature required by the specification: add a public void checkOrderReady() with no parameters. If internal logging is desired, implement a private helper (e.g., private void checkOrderReady(boolean enableLogging)) that contains the boolean-based behavior, and have the public no-arg checkOrderReady() call the helper (or remove logging entirely). Also update orderMeal() to call the public no-arg checkOrderReady() so the public API matches the problem statement and tests.
